title: Do Shark-Girls Dream Of Electric Chumbuds?

lines.en: I'm so— I bopped around so many places yesterday.
lines.ja: 昨日は… いろんなとこに行って大忙しだった

notes.meaning: あちこち動き回る、というカジュアルな言い方

lines.en: At one point, I found myself— I was, I was... in... in, like, a break room.
lines.ja: ぐらが… えっと… 休憩室みたいな場所にいた時

lines.en: And I fell asleep. And I didn't realize I had fallen asleep, but I had fallen asleep cuz there was nobody around. It was like dark.
lines.ja: うとうとしちゃったの 気づかぬ間に寝落ち 誰もいなかったし 薄暗くてさ…

lines.en: Dark, nobody around... I was like, "Oh, nap time for Gura!"
lines.ja: だから お昼寝タイムだ！と思って

lines.en: So I fell asleep with my head on my arms— like criss-crossed on the table...
lines.ja: 机に突っ伏して 腕組んで枕にして…

lines.en: And then the next thingー I don't remember how much time had passedー but the next thing I knew, my...
lines.ja: そしたらさぁ… どれだけ寝てたか知らないけど 次の瞬間…

lines.en: My manager was standing in front of me, like, "Hey, we gotta go. You got somewhere to be."
lines.ja: 目の前にマネージャーがいて 「はい、移動しますよ」「次の場所行きますよ」って

lines.en: And I thought I was, like, I had fallen in that area of sleep where you don't know where you are...
lines.ja: その時のぐらは… 眠りが深すぎたのか 自分がどこにいるか忘れちゃってて

notes.meaning: 「自分がどこにいるか分からなくなるほど深い眠り」を指す表現

lines.en: So I thought... In that moment, I thought I was like, back home in my, in my room or something?
lines.ja: だから 寝起きの瞬間… 自宅にいると思っちゃって…

lines.en: I was like, "How did... How did Manager get in my room? Why are you here? What did you— How— Where am I?"
lines.ja: 「マネージャー…？」「なんで家の中にいるの？」「なぜここに…？」「っていうか」「ここどこ？」

lines.en: And then I remembered where I was. I was like, "Oh, that's right! I'm, I'm in Japan.
lines.ja: で、今いる場所を思い出したの 「…そっか」「いま日本にいるんだった」

lines.en: I need a nap now. I'm tired. I need bedtime..."
lines.ja: 「いや眠っ」「疲れた…」「眠いよ」って…
